data.text:
Nand Lal Gupta vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food ... on 23 
October, 2024 
Author: Alok Mathur
Bench: Alok Mathur
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:71261
Court No. - 6
Case :- Writ - A No. - 9757 of 2024
Petitioner :- Nand Lal Gupta
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.  Food Safety Durg Administration Deptt. Gov Counsel for Petitioner :- Akhilesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.
1. Heard Sri Shishir Pradhan, Advocate holding brief of Sri Akhilesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents. 
2. It has been submitted by learned counsel for petitioner that the petitioner is working on the post of Food Safety Officer in the Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration when disciplinary proceedings were initiated against him in 2010 and the petitioner was placed under suspension. The disciplinary proceedings were concluded on 29.06.2012 wherein the petitioner was reinstated in service and the petitioner was exonerated from all the charges. 
Nand Lal Gupta vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food ... on 23 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197193422/
1 3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the respondents have not passed any order with regard to payment of full salary to the petitioner during the period he was under suspension, accordingly has made a prayer for a direction to the respondents to pay the amount due to him for the period he has spent as suspension.
4. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that grievance of the petition would be substantially redressed in case respondent no. 2-Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Lucknow, considers and decides the representation of the petitioner dated 12.04.2024 (Annexure No. 9 to the writ petition) in the time bound manner. 
5. Learned Standing Counsel has no objection to the aforesaid prayer. 
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without entering into the merits, respondent no. 2-Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Lucknow, is directed to decide representation of the petitioner dated 12.04.2024 (Annexure No. 9 to the writ petition) by speaking and reasoned order in accordance with law, expeditiously, say within a period of six weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order, in accordance with law, if there is no legal impediment. 
8. With above observations/directions, the writ petition stands disposed of. 
(Alok Mathur, J.) Order Date :- 23.10.2024 Ravi/
